title: Rhaly operators between Dirichlet-type spaces: a complete classification
summary: Let \(η=(η_n)_{n\ge0}\) be a complex sequence such that \(F_η(z)=\sum_{n\ge0}η_nz^n\in\Hol(\D)\), and let \(\mathcal R_{(η)}\) be the associated Rhaly operator. We give a complete characterization of boundedness and compactness of \(\mathcal R_{(η)}:\mathcal D^p_α\to\mathcal D^q_β\) for \(1 -1\). The characterization is formulated in terms of the \(H^q\)-norms of the dyadic blocks of \(F_η\).
